Mission Local reported that Mayor Daniel Lurie accepted an amendment drafted by Supervisor Myrna Melgar to remove rent-controlled buildings with three or more units from the upzoning plan. Its analysis estimated the exemption covered at least 84,000 rental units in 11,700 buildings, along with any ground-floor retail beneath them. Two-unit buildings remained covered, leaving tenants in those buildings potentially vulnerable to redevelopment.
